    • Method Detail

      • getFlags

        byte getFlags()
        This method returns the flags for the CID Field data which should be interpreted as a bit map. The flags represent which fields are present for the CID Field data. If the flag indicates that a field is not present, the user should clear that field. The bit values are:
        • 0x01 - Price
        • 0x02 - Size
        • 0x04 - Exchange
        • 0x08 - Time
        • 0x10 - Qualifiers
        • 0x20 - CID
        • 0x40 - Internal use
        • 0x80 - If set, "or" fields rather than set fields
        Returns:
        flags as a byte which should be interpreted as a bit map.

      • getExchangeTime

        @Deprecated
int getExchangeTime()
        Deprecated. a Java primitive int is unable to represent times after 03:14:07 UTC on 19 January 2038. Use getExchangeTimeAsInstant() or getExchangeTimeSeconds() instead. getExchangeTimeNanoseconds() can be used to get the nanoseconds portion of the exchange time.
        This method returns the exchange time for the CID Field data in seconds precision. The exchange time is sent from the exchange. If a particular exchange does not send the time, it will be the time the feed received the CID Field data. The value is the number of seconds since epoch.
        Returns:
        exchange time in seconds precision as an integer.
